Step by Step

Check-In Steps

1
Head to Tower C Lobby

Proceed to the Tower C reception at Fort Victoria, 5th Avenue, BGC.

2
Present a Valid ID

Show your ID at the front desk and let them know you're checking in for Unit 1107. They'll assist you in going up to the unit.

3
Get Your Keybox Code

Once you're in the lobby, message your host. We'll send the keybox access code right away.

4
Head Up to the 11th Floor — Unit 1107

The keybox is attached to the unit door. Enter the code to retrieve the key and let yourself in!

Important

House Rules

🚭 No smoking inside 💨 Vape is okay 👥 Registered guests only 🌙 Quiet 10PM–8AM 🐾 Pet-friendly

🚭 No Smoking Inside the Unit

Smoking inside is strictly prohibited. Vaping inside is okay. A ₱4,000 fine applies for smoking violations.

🚫 No Illegal Drugs

No illegal drugs or prohibited substances are allowed on the premises at any time.

👥 Registered Guests Only

Only guests registered at check-in are allowed to stay overnight. Max 4 guests.

🌙 Quiet Hours: 10PM – 8AM

Please be mindful of noise levels during quiet hours out of respect for neighbors.

🐾 Pets Welcome

Fur babies are welcome! A ₱350 pet cleaning fee applies. Please watch over your pet to avoid any damage.

⚠️ Violations

Any violation of house rules may result in additional cleaning fees or penalties in accordance with platform policies.

💬 Feel free to message us anytime if you need assistance, recommendations, or have any requests. We're happy to help!

Important

House Rules

👥 Max 4 Guests 🚭 No Smoking Inside 🐾 Pets Welcome 💖 Good Vibes Only

🚭 No Smoking Inside the Unit

Smoking inside the unit is strictly prohibited to keep the space clean and fresh for all guests. Vaping inside is okay. A ₱4,000 fine will be applied for smoking violations.

👥 Maximum Occupancy

This unit accommodates up to 4 guests comfortably. All guests must register at the building lobby upon arrival.

🐾 Pet Policy

Pets are welcome! A ₱350 cleaning fee applies to maintain hygiene standards for all guests.

🔊 Noise & Respect

Please be mindful of neighbors, especially during late hours. Keep noise at a reasonable level in hallways and common areas.

🏠 Care for the Space

The unit is carefully prepared before each check-in — clean, complete, and damage-free. Any pre-existing concerns are noted. Please treat the space with care and respect.

🎒 Lost Items

The host is not responsible for any lost items or incidents during your stay. Please keep your valuables secure.

🗑️ Trash

Please bag your trash before checkout and leave it inside the unit — housekeeping handles disposal. Never leave trash in hallways or common areas.

📺 Smart TV Accounts

You're welcome to sign into your own Netflix or streaming accounts on the Smart TVs. Please log out before checkout.

💚 Good vibes only! This space was built with love — please treat it as your own. We're sure you'll feel right at home.

11:00 AM

If the waste bin is full, please dispose of it in the Garbage Room located just beside the elevator — turn right as you exit the unit.

Please leave the kitchen clean and ready for the next guest.

❄️ Turn off all air-conditioning units & lights

Both ACs (first floor and second floor) and all lights should be switched off before leaving.

✓

✓
📺 Return all remotes to their holders

Please leave the remotes in their designated holders in the living room and bedroom.

🔑 Lock the door & return key to the keybox

After locking up, return the key to the keybox. Don't forget to scramble / rotate the code to secure it!

✓
🎒 Double-check you haven't left anything behind

Check under pillows, in drawers, and in both bathrooms before heading out.
